title: Use agricultural chemicals only as the approved label instructs
what: Use a registered agricultural chemical product only as its approved label instructs, unless a permit authorises otherwise.

laws.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 2004 (NT)

sources.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not use a registered agricultural chemical product in a way that is contrary to the instructions on the approved label unless authorised under a permit
